_meta.notes: Comprehensive index of all thematic clusters (Level 4) and sub-clusters (Level 5) for Palau.

sub_clusters.name: Austronesian Arrival
sub_clusters.description: Settlement from Island Southeast Asia or the Philippines; earliest pottery.

sub_clusters.name: Monumental Earthwork Terraces
sub_clusters.description: Massive hilltop terraces on Babeldaob; some of largest earthworks in Pacific.

920.name: Pre-Contact Palauan Society
920.description: Complex chieftainship system; bai meeting houses; storyboard tradition.

sub_clusters.name: Dual Chiefly System
sub_clusters.description: Ibedul and Reklai paramount chiefs; ranked village system; udoud money.

sub_clusters.name: Bai Meeting Houses
sub_clusters.description: Elaborately decorated communal meeting houses; storyboard carvings.

930.name: European Contact
930.description: British shipwreck; Spanish claim; trade contacts.

sub_clusters.name: Captain Henry Wilson Shipwreck
sub_clusters.description: East India Company ship Antelope wrecks; Prince Lee Boo travels to England.

sub_clusters.name: Spanish Colonial Claim
sub_clusters.description: Spain claims Palau; Capuchin missionaries; minimal administration.

940.name: German and Japanese Colonial Periods
940.description: Germany buys from Spain; Japan mandates after WWI; Koror as colonial capital.

sub_clusters.name: Japanese Mandate Period
sub_clusters.description: Nan'yō-chō administration; 25,000 Japanese settlers; Koror developed; cultural assimilation.

950.name: World War II — Battle of Peleliu
950.description: One of the bloodiest Pacific battles; controversial necessity.

sub_clusters.name: Battle of Peleliu
sub_clusters.description: US Marines vs entrenched Japanese; 2 months; 10,000+ Japanese, 1,800 US killed.

sub_clusters.name: Battle of Angaur
sub_clusters.description: US Army 81st Infantry; phosphate island secured.

950.name: Trust Territory Period
950.description: US administers Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands; Palau's long path to independence.

sub_clusters.name: TTPI Administration
sub_clusters.description: US strategic trust; education expansion; cash economy introduction.

sub_clusters.name: Nuclear-Free Constitution
sub_clusters.description: World's first nuclear-free constitution; 8 referendums to amend for US Compact.

sub_clusters.name: Palau Independence (1994)
sub_clusters.description: Compact of Free Association with US; independence 1 October 1994.

960.name: Contemporary Palau
960.description: Marine conservation leadership; tourism; geopolitical positioning.

sub_clusters.name: Palau National Marine Sanctuary
sub_clusters.description: 80% of EEZ protected; world-leading ocean conservation.

sub_clusters.name: Rock Islands UNESCO World Heritage
sub_clusters.description: Rock Islands Southern Lagoon; 445 limestone islands; jellyfish lake.

sub_clusters.name: Palau Pledge
sub_clusters.description: Passport-stamped environmental pledge by visitors; sustainable tourism.
